32314.german_description: Diese BH ist ein Must-have in jedem Frauenkleiderschrank! Aus glatter, hochwertiger Mikrofaser gefertigt. 32314.english_description: This bra is a must-have in every woman's wardrobe! Made entirely of smooth, high quality microfiber. Cups of fantastic construction, which optically enlarge even small breasts. Cut designed for special tasks.
